name: mem-kb
description: A self-hosted knowledge workspace for sourced RAG, notes, graphs, evaluation, and continuous knowledge consolidation.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend/app install && npm --prefix frontend install && bun install --cwd backend/gbrain
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend/app run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend/app run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend/app run test && npm --prefix frontend run test
scripts.audit: npm --prefix backend/app audit --audit-level=high && npm --prefix frontend audit --audit-level=high
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
